Andromeda 2.0 is based on [Aurora](https://github.com/eamonxg/luci-theme-aurora).

- Always visible desktop sidebar with all sections expanded.
- Smaller spacing in navigation, forms, tables and cards.
- Plain light/dark backgrounds on admin and login pages.
- Mobile drawer, search and Aurora's client-side navigation preserved.

Use the `.apk` package on OpenWrt 25.12, or the `.ipk` on OpenWrt 24.10.
Installation and migration from earlier Andromeda versions:
[README](https://github.com/kostenkodm/luci-theme-andromeda#установка-и-обновление).
